_doc: The brand registry: one record per brand the store carries. Facts come from the brand's official site (source + date) or from the store's own catalog; nothing else. 'look' is the brand's visual logic on this site, measured from its real packaging photos (dominant colours, projects/edencosmetic/brands-research.md). New brands found by the autonomy loop (scripts/evolve.mjs) are added with status 'draft' and only the catalog facts, until a person verifies the rest.
